title: Glass Rain — ANIMEFORGE Engine Demonstration
description: An original courier races across a neon megacity while an energy blade ignites above the rain-soaked street.

style.visual_identity: Original high-energy 2.5D cyberpunk action anime with graphic silhouettes, expressive posing and layered painted depth.
style.lighting: Hard magenta/cyan edge lights, warm practicals, deep ink shadows and restrained bloom.
style.linework: Bold clean silhouette outlines, cel-shaded planes, fine facial details and controlled graphic highlights.
style.camera: Wide cinematic 16:9 lens, foreground occlusion, motivated trucking, push-ins and depth parallax.
style.motion: Anticipation, readable key poses, arcs, overlapping hair/clothing, impact holds and directional speed lines.

characters.name: Ari Venn
characters.design_notes: Original young adult courier with short swept-back dark hair, a single teal hair streak, graphite flight jacket and amber visor. No recognizable franchise design.

characters.name: Wraith Drone
characters.design_notes: Original hovering security machine with a compact angular silhouette, one hot-pink optic and articulated stabilizer fins.

shots.action: Ari sprints through a rain-soaked neon avenue as traffic streaks behind.
shots.camera: low tracking wide shot, foreground signs parallax past lens

shots.action: A Wraith drone drops into frame and scans the avenue with a sharp magenta beam.
shots.camera: fast tilt-up into a compressed medium shot

shots.action: Ari plants a foot, twists the torso and ignites a cyan energy blade.
shots.camera: three-quarter orbit with a tight impact push

shots.action: Ari launches forward; rain and neon reflections burst outward in a freeze-frame finish.
shots.camera: accelerating dolly, then a sharp held hero composition
